title: Thai Coconut Chicken Stir Fry
description: A keto-friendly Thai-inspired stir fry with chicken, coconut milk, and crispy elements.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the Thai coconut milk and stir to combine with the curry paste and mushrooms.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Add the Thai basil (kao manow), crispy fried shallots, and Thai chilies (mun chee) to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot and garnish with additional Thai basil if desired.
